name: track
description: A four-layer, in-repo tracking framework (vision -> roadmap -> stories -> designs) with a deterministic status board generated from story frontmatter. Slash commands cover the full story lifecycle; a self-orienting skill teaches any agent to read the board and pick up the next ready story. The impl-coord skill works the backlog autonomously: it resumes unfinished work, fans independent ready stories out to isolated worktree implementors, verifies each one's merge-base failing-first proof, reviews diffs as evidence, integrates serially with the gate green after every merge, and cuts a release when the backlog drains — doing the reversible half and handing registry publishes over unrun.
